overall_intent: The current requester changes only surreal to three within the continuing three independent concept portrait test. I choose a vertical tide meeting a normal sea as one dominant spatial impossibility, with a person making a small visible contact that reveals its reality. I compared a folded station interior and a gravity-reversed seascape; the continuous right-angle sea gives a more immediately legible boundary, scale and intimate encounter. The station, wardrobe, pose and hand contact are replaceable authored staging, not requester facts. Reference use is visible face and hair only, without biography or identity inference. Sensual one supports subtle presence while surreal three governs the whole frame.
